instruction: Modify Ubuntu's boot settings to launch into the terminal instead of the GUI.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because it requires changing the systemd default target and would require a system reboot to verify. The OSWorld environment cannot reliably test boot-level configuration changes, as they require restarting the VM and verifying the boot behavior, which is outside the scope of the evaluation framework.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly marked as infeasible with valid justification
Boot-level system configuration changes (systemd default target) cannot be verified without VM reboot
Verification would require checking boot behavior, which is outside OSWorld evaluation framework capabilities
The 'infeasible' evaluator is appropriately used for tasks that are fundamentally unverifiable within framework constraints
